```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(AzimuthAPI) # need to install via github with devtools or remotes
# needs to be set for large dataset analysis
options(future.globals.maxSize = 5e9)

cb_lane1 <- read_rds("data_cytobrushes/CB1_Seurat.rds")
cb_lane1$Lane <- "Lane 1"
cb_lane2 <- read_rds("data_cytobrushes/CB2_Seurat.rds")
cb_lane2$Lane <- "Lane 2"

cb <- merge(cb_lane1, cb_lane2)

```

```{r}
# THIS CHUNK ADDS METADATA (PTID AND PHASE) TO THE SAMPLES

# To add metadata with AddMetaData, you need a dataframe with rownames that match 
# the rownames from the SeuratObject 
# Steps:
# 1. Get current metadata out of object
metadata <- cb@meta.data %>% 
    mutate(Rownames = rownames(.))

# 2. Select columns you want to add 
to_add <- metadata %>% 
    separate(Sample_Name, into = c("Ptid", "Sample", "Phase"), sep = "_") |> 
    select(Rownames, Sample, Ptid, Phase) %>% 
    as.data.frame()

# NAs come from cells that were identified as multiplets (multiple sample tags) 
# or undetermined (too few sample tags)

# 3. Add back rownames which tidyverse removes
rownames(to_add) <- to_add$Rownames
to_add <- select(to_add, -Rownames)

# 5. Add the new metadata to the Seurat Object
cb <- AddMetaData(cb, to_add)
```

```{r}
# THIS CHUNK CHECKS THE QC METRICS AND FILTERS OUT LOW QUALITY CELLS

# check QC metrics

# The [[ operator can add columns to object metadata. This is a great place to stash QC stats
cb[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(cb, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics as a violin plot
# have some cells with  really high transcript counts, most cells have info about ~2k genes, a few cells have a higher percentage of mt transcripts

VlnPlot(cb, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0)

VlnPlot(cb, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0, group.by = "Phase")

VlnPlot(cb, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 1, group.by = "Ptid")

#dropoff at about 75k
cb$nCount_RNA  %>%  
    hist(breaks= 100)

#lowest counts are around 170K
sort(cb$nCount_RNA) %>% tail(n = 20)
#highest are around 4K
sort(cb$nCount_RNA) %>% head(n = 20)

cb$nFeature_RNA  %>%  
    hist(breaks= 100)

#highest is around 11K
sort(cb$nFeature_RNA) %>% tail(n = 20)
#lowest are around 300
sort(cb$nFeature_RNA) %>% head(n = 20)

# FeatureScatter is typically used to visualize feature-feature relationships, but can be used
# for anything calculated by the object, i.e. columns in object metadata, PC scores etc.
p1 <- FeatureScatter(cb, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 15) + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 7.5E4)

p2 <- FeatureScatter(cb, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1000) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 9000) + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 7.5E4)

p1 + p2
ggsave("images/cb/prefilter_quality_metrics.png", width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)

#subset for nCount, nFeature and percent.mt. Tutorial does not have an nCount subset but we are adding one because we don't want info from the cells that only have a few transcripts read
#our cutoffs are based on the histograms made above

cb_subset <- subset(cb, 
    subset = nFeature_RNA > 1000 & percent.mt < 15)

FeatureScatter(cb_subset, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") + 
    FeatureScatter(cb_subset, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
ggsave("images/cb/postfilter_quality_metrics.png", width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)

#check violins again after subsetting
VlnPlot(cb_subset, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0)

#comparing our original and subset objects, we've removed about 3k cells, not much!! Lol
cb_subset
cb
```

## Cell numbers

```{r}
input <- readxl::read_excel("J:/Projects/Progesterone_R01/Experiments/scRNAseq/Tissue/Rhapsody runs/2026-08-26_cytobrush/01-sample prep/Endocervical Cytobrush real.xlsx", sheet = "Count and viability", range = "A1:N17")

# input cell numbers are based on the input to the CD45 enrichment
input_pcts <- input |> 
    mutate(Input = case_when(
        SpecimenCode == "H_E_L" ~ 0.75E6,
        is.na(`total in 275ul`) ~ `(no recount)`,
        is.na(`(no recount)`) ~ `total in 275ul`
    )) |> 
    mutate(Lane = ifelse(`Pool/Lane` == "A", "Lane 1", "Lane 2")) |> 
    group_by(Lane) |> 
    mutate(InputPct = Input/sum(Input) * 100) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    select(Lane, Sample_Name = `SpecimenCode`, InputPct)

cb_processed@meta.data |> 
    group_by(Lane) |> 
    summarise(Recovered = n()) |>  
    ungroup() |> 
    mutate(LoadedTotal = ifelse(Lane == "Lane 1", 36800, 58880)) |>
    mutate(LoadedViable = ifelse(Lane == "Lane 1", 10930, 19018)) |>
    pivot_longer(-Lane, names_to = "Category", values_to = "Number") |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Lane, y = Number, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") + 
    ylab("Number of cells")
ggsave("images/cb/cell_input_vs_recovery.png", width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)

cb_processed@meta.data |> 
    group_by(Ptid, Lane) |> 
    count() |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Lane, y = n, fill = Ptid)) +
    geom_col() + 
    ylab("Number of cells")
ggsave("images/cb/cell_recovery_by_donor.png", width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)

cb_processed@meta.data |> 
    group_by(Phase, Lane) |> 
    count() |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Lane, y = n, fill = Phase)) +
    geom_col() + 
    ylab("Number of cells")
ggsave("images/cb/cell_recovery_by_phase.png", width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)

cb_processed@meta.data |> 
    filter(!Ptid %in% c("Multiplet", "Undetermined")) |>
    group_by(Sample_Name, Lane) |> 
    count() |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    mutate(Percent = n/sum(n) * 100) |> 
    mutate(Percent = round(Percent, 1)) |> 
    right_join(input_pcts) |> 
    mutate(Percent = ifelse(is.na(Percent), 0, Percent)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Percent, y = InputPct)) + 
    geom_point() + facet_wrap(~Lane) + 
    coord_equal() + 
    ylab("Expected percent of cells") + 
    xlab("Observed percent of cells") + 
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(aes(label = Sample_Name), nudge_x = 10)

cb_processed@meta.data |> 
    filter(!Ptid %in% c("Multiplet", "Undetermined")) |> 
    group_by(Ptid, Phase) |> 
    count() |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Phase, y = n, color = Ptid)) + 
    geom_line(aes(group = Ptid)) + 
    geom_point() + 
    scale_y_log10() + 
    ylab("Number of cells (log10)")
ggsave("images/cb/cell_number_by_ptid.png", width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# THIS CHUNK DOES PRE-PROCESSING
cb_processed <- cb_subset |> 
    subset(subset = !Ptid %in% c("Multiplet", "Undetermined")) |> 
    NormalizeData() |> 
    FindVariableFeatures() |> 
    ScaleData() |> 
    RunPCA() |> 
    FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca") |> 
    FindClusters() |> 
    RunUMAP(dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca") |> 
    AzimuthAPI::CloudAzimuth(assay = "RNA")
```

## Add our own annotations based on azimuth and our brains

```{r}
# THIS CHUNK MAPS EACH CELL CLUSTER TO AN ANNOTATION BASED ON AZIMUTH AND OUR
# OBSERVATIONS

# describe each cluster with the most likely azimuth name
cell_annotations <- cb_processed@meta.data |> 
    rownames_to_column() |> 
    # simplify T cell labels to CD4 or CD8 (dropping memory labels)
    mutate(our_annotation = case_when(
        seurat_clusters == 12 ~ "B cell",
        seurat_clusters == 15 ~ "Cycling cell",
        seurat_clusters == 14 ~ "Epithelial cell",
        seurat_clusters %in% c(3, 7, 11, 13) ~ "T cell",
        seurat_clusters %in% c(0, 1, 6, 8, 10) ~ "Macrophage",
        seurat_clusters %in% c(2, 4, 5, 9) ~ "Monocyte"
    )) |> 
    select(rowname, seurat_clusters, our_annotation)

rownames(cell_annotations) <- cell_annotations$rowname
cell_annotations <- select(cell_annotations, -rowname)

# add our_annotations into the metadata for cb_processed 
cb_processed <- AddMetaData(cb_processed, cell_annotations)

# make the default Ident be "our_annotation"
# otherwise it gives a bunch of problems
Idents(cb_processed) <- "our_annotation"
```

## Differential expression

| Function | sc or bulk | Test | Pairing | Latent var | File name |
|----|----|----|----|----|----|
| do_de_test | single-cell | MAST | paired | Ptid | de_genes |
| do_de_test_mast_unpaired | single-cell | MAST | unpaired | None | mast_unpaired_de_genes |
| do_de_test_mast_unpaired_latent_nCount | single-cell | MAST | unpaired | nCount_RNA | mast_unpaired_latent_nCount_de_genes |
| do_de_test_pseudobulked | pseudobulk | DESeq2 | unpaired | None | pseudobulked_de_genes |

```{r}
# THIS CHUNK CALCULATES DE GENES BY CYCLE PHASE

# function to test for differentially expressed genes by phase within specified
# cell population, adjusting for ptid 
do_de_test <- function(data, annotation) {
    print(paste("running", annotation))
    # subset the seurat object to cells of interest
    subsetted <- subset(data, subset = our_annotation == annotation) 
    
    # specify comparison between phases
    Idents(subsetted) <- "Phase"
    
    de_results <- FindMarkers(subsetted, 
        ident.1 = "F",
        ident.2 = "L",
        test.use = "MAST", 
        # accounts for pairing between samples
        latent.var = "Ptid") |> 
        # store gene names in a column
        rownames_to_column("gene") |> 
        # record cell population
        mutate(our_annotation = annotation) 
    
    # save a file with the results 
    #write_csv(de_results, paste0("results/", annotation, "_de_genes.csv"))
    print(de_results[1:5, ] |> as_tibble())
    
    # return the results
    de_results
}

# function to test for differentially expressed genes by phase within specified
# cell population, adjusting for ptid 
do_de_test_pseudobulked <- function(data, annotation) {
    print(paste("running", annotation))
    # subset the seurat object to cells of interest
    subsetted <- subset(data, subset = our_annotation == annotation) |> 
        AggregateExpression(return.seurat = TRUE, group.by = c("Ptid", "Phase"))
    
    # specify comparison between phases
    Idents(subsetted) <- "Phase"
    
    de_results <- FindMarkers(subsetted, 
        ident.1 = "F",
        ident.2 = "L",
        test.use = "DESeq2") |> 
        # store gene names in a column
        rownames_to_column("gene") |> 
        # record cell population
        mutate(our_annotation = annotation) 
    
    # save a file with the results 
    #write_csv(de_results, paste0("results/", annotation, "_pseudobulked_de_genes.csv"))
    
    print(de_results[1:5, ] |> as_tibble())
    
    # return the results
    de_results
}

# get names of each population in reverse order of population size
# so it runs the smallest populations first
populations <- cb_processed@meta.data |> group_by(our_annotation) |> count() |> 
    arrange(n) |> pull(our_annotation)

DefaultAssay(cb_processed) <- "RNA"
# run DE tests for every cell population PSEUDOBULKED
de_genes_by_phase_pseudobulked <- map(populations, function(popn) do_de_test_pseudobulked(cb_processed, popn)) |> 
    bind_rows()

# run DE tests for every cell population MAST LATENT VAR
de_genes_by_phase <- map(populations, function(popn) do_de_test(cb_processed, popn)) |> 
    bind_rows()


VlnPlot(cb_processed |> subset(our_annotation == "Monocyte"), "DGKI", 
    group.by = "Ptid", split.by = "Phase")

```
